_: The diary card's OWN buttons, which no scenario had ever pressed: the notes under the title, a row's statistics, a row's comment, and the two exports at the foot. Every one of them is drawn by both sides — the reference's Home carries three hundred of the comment button alone — and on this side every one of them is dead. `handled: false` in this trace is that, recorded rather than remembered. Poista is deliberately not here: a delete moves every card after it, and the gap is the same one.
